verses: In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth.
And the earth was without form, and void;and darkness was upon the face of the deep.
And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
And God saw the light<S>216</S>, that <J>it was good</J><n>note one</n>.

Thus the heavens and the earth were finished
and all the host of them.
For God so loved the world<f>1</f>, that he gave his only begotten Son.
For God sent not his Son<m>V-AAI-3S</m> into the world to condemn the world.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
